player.beatTheClockDesc: Timer counts down each question. Single choice locks in instantly; multi-select needs Submit before zero.
player.speedBonusDesc: Every question has base points. Answering instantly can add up to +50% bonus; slower answers earn less.

player.hintDesc: Reveal the question hint (when available). Uses your limited hints.
player.copyDesc: Pick a teammate and mirror their answer. If they don't answer in time, you miss out too.
player.doublePointsDesc: Doubles your score for that question after speed and accuracy are calculated.
player.noPowerUpsDesc: The host hasn't enabled power-ups for this game—focus on speed and accuracy.
player.timesUpDesc: The host will reveal the answers shortly. Sit tight!

player.doubleActive: Double Points Active - Your score will be doubled!
player.categoriseAssignAll: Assign every item to a category to submit

admin.quizzesDescription: Create, host, and manage your quiz library
admin.sourceLanguageHint: The language the quiz content is originally written in. Translations are generated from this language.
admin.deleteQuizDescription: This will permanently delete the quiz and all its questions, answers, and translations. This action cannot be undone.
admin.extraDetailsPlaceholder: Tone, target audience, must-cover facts, or imagery guidance (English only).
admin.reviewBeforeHosting: Review hints, answers, and host notes before hosting.
admin.pleaseChooseZip: Please choose a .zip file to import
admin.importError: Something went wrong while importing the quiz.
admin.pleaseAddTopic: Please add a topic or theme for the quiz.
admin.sectionCountRange: Section count must be between 0 and the number of questions.
admin.askingAi: Asking AI to draft your quiz...
admin.quizCreatedByAi: Quiz created by AI. Review answers carefully.
admin.failedToCreateWithAi: Failed to create quiz with AI
admin.failedToGenerateWithAi: Failed to generate quiz with AI
admin.questionsHelp: We will balance answers, hints, and host notes automatically.
admin.sectionsHelp: Sections act as grouped intros; they'll include optional images.
admin.extraDetailsHelp: AI will return English-only content with hints, host notes, and images when useful.
admin.aiAssembling: We'll assemble questions, hints, host notes, and images. Everything stays in English and should be reviewed before use.
admin.aiDialogDescription: Share what you need and we will draft the quiz in English with hints, host notes, and suggested images where relevant. Review the result carefully before hosting.
admin.unsplashHint: Add an Unsplash access key in Settings to let AI include real images automatically.
admin.reviewEveryAnswer: Review every answer, hint, and host note before hosting.
admin.importDescription: Upload a quiz export (.zip) to add it to your collection. Images and translations are imported automatically.
admin.importHelpText: Use the Export button inside a quiz to download a .zip that includes questions, sections, images, and translations.
admin.deleteConfirm: This will permanently delete {title} and all of its questions. This action cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupRestoreDesc: Export your API keys and settings to an encrypted file for backup or migration.
settings.exportNotice: Your export file is encrypted with a password. Keep your password safe - it cannot be recovered.

settings.publicUrlHint: This URL will be used for QR codes when you host a game.
settings.shortioDesc: Generate short URLs for join links to make them easier to share. Get a free API key and find your domain at {link}.
settings.domainHint: Your Short.io domain (find it in your Short.io dashboard)
settings.shortioHint: Short URLs will automatically be generated for join links when available. If URL shortening fails, the full URL will be used as a fallback.
settings.unsplashDesc: Provide an Unsplash Access Key to let AI-created quizzes include real images. Get a key at {link}.
settings.unsplashKeyHint: Stored securely and only used server-side for image lookup.

settings.removeNgrokDesc: This will stop your external tunnel until you add a new token. Are you sure you want to continue?
settings.removeShortioDesc: Are you sure you want to remove your Short.io API key and domain? Your join links will no longer be shortened.
settings.removeUnsplashDesc: AI quiz creation will stop attaching Unsplash images if you remove this key.
